tables.name: Unknown Origin
tables.description: Special Feature specifics: Unknown Origin. If an unknown origin conflicts with earlier rolls, the unknown origin takes precedence.

results.name: Extraplanar
results.description: The fortress popped into existence instantaneously.

results.name: Unseen Hands
results.description: The fortress was built without anyone ever seeing a builder. It seemed to grow, unobserved, each day until it was finished.

results.name: Stranger
results.description: Someone integral to the inception of the fortress was unknown to anyone else involved.

results.name: No Records
results.description: The fortress was built by people who are no longer around, and no records give clues as to who they were.
